title: How Rory McIlroy’s £1 million gift helped Daisy Lodge
summary_full: Rory McIlroy donated £1 million to establish Daisy Lodge, a center for families with children suffering from cancer. Since its opening in 2014, over 4,000 families have benefited from therapeutic short breaks at the lodge. The center provides support through workshops and complementary therapies while creating a space for families to connect. Tragically, some families have also received bereavement support following the loss of loved ones.
